summary:
Scope: the state of Claude usage measurement on the fdev workspace after the closed-transcript backlog was captured and accepted (#4638). This is a recorded decision boundary, not current authority or a description of live state; refresh from the receiver and #4638 before any action.

What exists: a published Host that receives Claude transcript provenance, and a capture path run by hand over selections of closed transcript files with a bounded foreground loop. The unattended part is only the drain of whatever is already queued, on a timer.

Explicitly not in place, by recorded decision: continuous capture of new Claude sessions (no capture timer or daemon; a separate Claude producer was proposed in two variants, one with a separate principal and one sharing the principal, and was declined for now); the transcripts of agents that were still running when the plan was frozen (deferred to a later wave after those agents are closed, to be admitted separately); the live main session (excluded from manual waves, to be decided together with continuous capture); transcripts created after the plan was frozen (not counted); and any attribution of usage to dispatches. A reader of the telemetry therefore sees a closed-backlog snapshot plus whatever later admitted waves add, not complete current coverage. Do not describe this as live or complete measurement.

Operational limits to remember when a later wave is admitted: the capacity and pacing lesson (github/claude-backlog-capture-capacity-and-pacing), the coverage limits (github/claude-transcript-capture-coverage-limits), and the timer overlap lesson (github/telemetry-drain-timer-and-manual-capture-overlap). A shared-principal second association needs no receiver change but shares the per-producer pending cap; a separate principal needs an additive receiver configuration entry and a restart. Neither was admitted. Rollback and seal artifacts from the cutover are kept for a window set by the owner; their deletion is its own admission. The parent outcome (qualified operational collection with explicit Unknown cases) stays open in the roadmap.
title: fdev Claude telemetry is manual, bounded capture of closed transcripts; continuous capture and live-agent transcripts are explicit Unknown or unsupported cases
